name: ASTERIAL
releaseNotes: Repaired Android authentication & networking ('Network request failed' root-cause fix): decoupled CI build-time environment generation from placeholder builds, added native Android HttpsURLConnection fallback, strict NetworkSecurityConfig TLS enforcement, and actionable error diagnostics

Orbits community platform across Web & native Android: public and private communities, #announcements and multi-channel discussions, owner/admin/member governance, moderation controls, and cursor-paginated history

Moments temporary updates across Web & native Android: 6h/12h/24h/48h expiring text and photo updates with database RLS expiration enforcement, audience controls, view tracking, and full-screen viewer

Chronological Social Feed across Web & native Android: persistent text and photo posts, transactional likes and comments, visibility rules, cursor pagination, editing, deletion, blocking, and reporting
Complete v1.4.0 monochrome UI/UX overhaul across Web & Android plus multi-ABI + universal APK verification and automated tag-driven GitHub Release pipeline
